description: A pair of logistic maps iterating once per sample in their chaotic range, giving two related noise voltages

params.text: Sets the map's parameter across the chaotic band from 3.56 to 3.9, where the higher settings are the noisier
Attenuates the voltage at the jack beneath it before it reaches the map's parameter
Moves the Y map's parameter above the X map's by up to a tenth, so the two outputs drift apart

inputs.text: Modulates the map's parameter through the attenuator above it; ±5V here moves the parameter by up to a fortieth

outputs.text: Carries the first map, -5V to 5V, a fresh value every sample
Carries the second map, -5V to 5V, running the same equation with the offset added to its parameter

notes: the module runs at the sample rate with no filtering, so both outputs are broadband noise; the chaos knob near its bottom end gives the most structured result
the two maps start from the same value and only separate because of the offset knob; with the offset at zero they track each other exactly
